title: Circumference
text: The circumference of a unit circle is $$2\pi$$.

title: Fraction of the circumference
text: If $$\theta=5\pi/4$$ then the total circumference of the circle travelled is $$\frac{\frac{5\pi}{4}}{2\pi}$$

title: Identify the point
text: The angle $$\theta$$ is $$\frac{5}{8} th$$ of the circumference of the circle, moving in the counterclockwise direction. That corresponds to point C.

title: Identify the point
text: Note that $$\frac{5}{8} th$$ of the circumference is an additional $$\frac{1}{8}$$ beyond the halfway point around the circle since $$\frac{5}{8}=\frac{4}{8}+\frac{1}{8}=\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{8}$$.
